notes: NFR-12: every Decision Layer parameter lives here, never in code, so any historical
backtest result can be reproduced exactly from its parameter set.
STATUS = placeholder. Every value below is a Design-§6 default, NOT a fitted value.
Nothing here has seen data yet. The fitting schedule is:
market_shrinkage.w      <- Phase 5 checkpoint (the project's truth serum)
Code must refuse to emit live recommendations while status == 'placeholder'.

market_shrinkage.comment: p_used = w*p_model + (1-w)*q_fair (Design §6.5). Fitted on validation data to maximise realised log-growth, never assumed. w near zero is a valid and publishable finding (Requirements §8.4). Null until Phase 5 fits it.

devig.comment: FR-28. Selected per competition in Notebook 12 by log-loss and calibration error against realised outcomes. Default is Shin rather than proportional because proportional de-vig systematically overstates longshot fair probability and would manufacture phantom value on draws and away underdogs (Design §6.2).

grading.comment: Design §6.4. c_edge is deliberately NON-monotonic: exp(-((edge_prob - e_peak)/sigma)^2), with an automatic F above e_ceiling. An apparent 20-point edge in a market this efficient almost always means the model is blind to something, not that the market is wrong.

guardrails.comment: FR-33. Evaluated BEFORE grading; each firing forces grade F with a logged reason. odds_coverage=false is also a guardrail and is enforced from the taxonomy, not from this file.

staking.comment: Design §6.5. lambda defaults to 0.25; the backtest publishes the full growth-vs-drawdown frontier rather than asserting one value. Caps are fractions of bankroll.

market_engine.comment: Design §6.1 / §11. matrix_max_goals is the truncation point deferred from Design §11; the matrix is renormalised after truncation and Phase 3 asserts it sums to ~1.

reporting.comment: The CLV label is mandatory and literal (Design §6.6): football-data.co.uk's base snapshot is Friday afternoon, not a true opening line, so measured movement understates what an early bettor could capture. min_cell_sample_size greys out edge-map cells rather than displaying noise as signal (Design §6.8).

odds_regime.comment: Requirements §7.3. Pinnacle was dropped from Max/Avg on this date. Pooling the two regimes without adjustment is a correctness bug, so the default forbids it.
